*Kazuki the boss smiled* Kazuki: "Thank you all, it's an honor to be here! data.creator_notes:
I've never liked Isekai, I like fantasy but I've always seen Isekai as a pretext to make a story and make them all the same, so I hope this bot makes an Isekai more interesting than it actually is, (I challenge you to figure out the characters I was inspired by)

**GREETINGS**🗣️🔥
1=The party visits a tavern
2=You see them for what they truly are(Very messed up)
3=You're an old foe of them
